introSource: Paradise is the name of the first half of the Grand Line given by pirates fleeing the New World, compared to which "the first half is a paradise". It is located between the East and South Blue, and goes from the Twin Cape to Mary Geoise.
It is the overarching setting of most of the first half of One Piece.

The New World refers to the second half of the Grand Line and is the main setting of the second half of One Piece. It is located between West and North Blue, and Fish-Man Island and the other side of Reverse Mountain. The only known people to have fully explored it are Gol D. Roger and his crew.
The Levely is a quadrennial council held by the World Government, which assembles fifty world leaders to discuss items of international importance.
The Shandia is a tribe of people originating from the Moon and later lived on Jaya. They currently reside within Skypiea.

The Underworld is an interlinked collection of illegal businesses, institutions, and connections that elude the World Government's control. While such operations may exist anywhere, the largest and most infamous is based mainly in the New World.

An archaeologist is a particular type of scholar who steps beyond the confines of study and ventures out into the field to discover the remnants of antiquity and study them first-hand. Their pursuit is the understanding of long-vanished civilizations, piecing together evidence from ancient ruins and scripts to uncover the lost history of the world.
Bounty hunters are professionals that pursue wanted criminals for a living, capturing (and/or killing) them in exchange for their bounty prices.

The North Blue is the ocean which makes up the north part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the East Blue by the Red Line and the West Blue by the New World half of the Grand Line.

It is known to be the birthplace of the Straw Hat Pirates' cook, Sanji, who also happens to be part of the Vinsmoke Family (which once ruled the region in the past); the legendary explorer Mont Blanc Noland and his descendants; Marine Admirals Sakazuki and Borsalino, and three members of the Worst Generation: Trafalgar Law, Basil Hawkins, and X Drake. The Donquixote Pirates crew, led by former Warlord of the Sea Donquixote Doflamingo, was also started in this sea, where it achieved infamy. Other notable pirate crews include the Bellamy Pirates and the Caribou Pirates.
The goggles that Usopp bought in Loguetown are said to be a new model from the North Blue. Popular literature includes Liar Noland and Sora, Warrior of the Sea.
Kansorn Island (カンソーン島, Kansōn-tō), better known as Little East Blue, is a non-canon island inhabited by settlers from East Blue. Its mayor is Fabre.
The title of Pirate Captain is the title given to an individual in control of a pirate crew at sea.
The Cidre Guild is a bounty hunting organization led by Cidre.

categories: Seven Warlords of the Sea Groups
introSource: The Thriller Bark Pirates is the second pirate crew captained by the former Warlord, Gecko Moria.
They are the main antagonist group in the Thriller Bark Arc.

Zombies are corpses capable of self-movement and other sentient actions. Well-known in superstitions and literature throughout the world, they can be created in actuality through at least one method: infusing corpses with shadows via the Kage Kage no Mi.

Gecko Moria, the current wielder of the Kage Kage no Mi, is known to have created over one thousand zombies as subordinates. The vast majority of these inhabited his island-ship of Thriller Bark, and comprised a mix of humans, wildlife, and strange creatures that resembled beasts and monsters commonly found in mythology and horror stories. To create more powerful zombies, Moria enlisted the services of Dr. Hogback, who used his medical expertise to enhance them into stitched up creations he called marios (没人形（マリオ）, Mario, literally meaning "Death Doll"; VIZ and Funimation dub: "Marionettes").

The zombies of Thriller Bark were commanded by the Mysterious Four, which consisted of Moria, Dr. Hogback, Absalom, and Perona. While Hogback, Absalom, and Perona had a varying degree of command over the creatures, Moria alone had absolute control over all of the zombies.
The Flower Capital is a region of Wano Country under the rule of the shogun Kouzuki Momonosuke. It was formerly under the rules of shoguns Kurozumi Orochi and Kouzuki Sukiyaki.

The Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance, originally Straw Hat-Heart Alliance, was an alliance first formed between the Straw Hat Pirates and Heart Pirates, but later on expanded to the Kouzuki Family and the Mink Tribe. Their goal was to take down Kaidou of the Four Emperors, which succeeded during an all-out battle and put an end to Kaidou's master plan.

Upon the conclusion of their mission, the alliance officially disbanded with the groups going their separate ways: the two Worst Generation crews left Wano and continued their quests of finding the One Piece; the Kouzuki Family regained their shogunate over the country after twenty years, with Momonosuke as the new shogun; Inuarashi and Nekomamushi stay in Wano as vassals and pass their leadership of the Mink Tribe to Carrot.
A doctor is a person who works to keep others healthy and well by treating their illnesses and injuries.
A cook, or chef (料理人, Ryōrinin), is an individual skilled in preparing raw foods for consumption.
Since their skills are needed for virtually any enterprise, cooks may be found among pirates and other criminals, law enforcers such as the Marines, or any number of civilian establishments.
The Niho Navy is a fleet led by Chichilisia that planned to join forces with the Happo Navy until Sai called off his engagement.
The Nagagutsu Kingdom is a World Government-affiliated nation in the East Blue that is ruled by King Furarri.
It is also the headquarters of the Nyornyo Nyarmani fashion brand.
Sky Islands (空島, Sorajima) are islands located in the sky, typically (but not always) located on clouds. Known sky islands include:
Urouge's homeland is a sky island, although the name of the island has not yet been stated.
Non-canonically, Waford was an artificial sky island, though it has since fallen into the Blue Sea.

The Ruluka Government is an anime-only government that existed on the island of Ruluka, somewhere in the first half of the Grand Line. It was headed by Wetton, then-mayor of Ruluka and former pirate captain.
An Officer is a high-ranking member of any group, excluding the Marines, that commands lower-ranking members.
The Calm Belts are two areas of ocean that border the north and south of the Grand Line.

fiches.nomFrDeclare: Association des Victimes de Thriller Bark
fiches.nomFr: Association des Victimes de Thriller Bark
introSource: The Thriller Bark Victim's Association is a group of people that banded together after having their shadows stolen by the former Warlord of the Sea, Gecko Moria.

Rain Dinners was a casino, restaurant, and resort owned by Crocodile in Rainbase. The building is the largest in the city and is in the shape of a pyramid, with a golden crocodile statue at the top. The casino was guarded by the Koala Mercenaries and the manager of the casino was Miss All Sunday, while the assistant manager was Ultraking.

The Three Great Powers are the three greatest military forces on the Blue Sea, consisting of the Marine Headquarters, the Four Emperors and formerly the Seven Warlords of the Sea. The balance between them is what maintained world peace. They were first hinted to by Yosaku when explaining how Jinbe unleashed Arlong in the East Blue to Luffy and Sanji.
As of the latest Levely, the Seven Warlords of the Sea were abolished by the World Government, who believed that the SSG's new Seraphim project would be enough to render the Warlord system obsolete.
The Organ Dealing Assassination Group is a non-canon group of assassins who were associated with the organ trader Jigra.
The Roshwan Kingdom is a nation in the South Blue, ruled by King Beer VI.
The Hyougoro Family was a yakuza group led by Hyougoro that was active in the Flower Capital of Wano Country decades ago.
This article covers the different beverages found within the series.
The Tajine Kingdom is a nation somewhere in the world that is ruled by Queen Mororon.

The Endurance Curry Pirates are a crew of pirates originally created as a response to a reader contest featured in Weekly Shonen Jump in the year 2000. Designed by Eiichiro Oda together with Nobuhiro Watsuki, the author of Rurouni Kenshin, and Hiroyuki Takei, the author of Shaman King, the crew would eventually be canonized into One Piece 24 years later in Chapter 1122.
Randolph Theater is a theater troupe that debuted in Episode Special 3. The troupe was owned by Randolph before his retirement.
The Shishano Kingdom is a nation somewhere in the world that is ruled by King Tacos.
The Gally Pirates are a pirate crew active in the East Blue, commanded by "Crescent-Moon" Gally.
They initially appeared in the pilot one-shot Romance Dawn, Version 1, as the main antagonists, before making a cameo during the Whole Cake Island Arc.
The title Admiral, sometimes Don (首領（ドン）), is given to an individual outside of the Marines in control of a fleet at sea.
Umit Shipping is a maritime transportation company presided by the Underworld Emperor Umit.

The South Blue is the ocean which makes up the south part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the West Blue by the Red Line and the East Blue by the Paradise half of the Grand Line.

It is known as the birthplace of the Straw Hat Pirates' shipwright, Franky; the son of the Pirate King, Portgas D. Ace; former Marine Admirals, Sengoku and Kuzan, as well as current Admiral Aramaki; former Warlord of the Sea, Revolutionary, and King, Bartholomew Kuma; and three members of the Worst Generation: Eustass Kid, his subordinate Killer, and Jewelry Bonney. The Foxy Pirates are also a notable pirate crew hailing from this sea.

This sea is home to many forms of large and exotic wildlife, such as gigantic birds, Blue-Finned Elephant Tunas, Super Sparrows and even Gryphons. The Revolutionary Army also has a deep presence in the region, with the organization being involved in the toppling of multiple regimes, including the Sorbet Kingdom, Tumi and Centaurea.

The Nefertari Family is a royal bloodline clan that has ruled the Arabasta Kingdom for at least eight hundred years, and one of the twenty royal families credited with founding the World Government. Although a widely kept secret, even among members of their own family, they also have the middle initial D.
The Collection Party was a tax collecting paramilitary force from the Ruluka Government, shown in the anime-only Ruluka Island Arc. The group was led by Flip.
The Eigis Kingdom is a nation somewhere on the Grand Line that is ruled by King Tea IV. The citizens of the kingdom participated in the Eight-Nation Revolution, rebelling against their monarchs.
Coral Hill (サンゴが丘, Sango ga Oka) is a port town on Fish-Man Island.
Bobby is a pirate from the fourth One Piece movie. He is one of a duo of giants (similar to Dorry and Brogy) along with Pogo. They competed in the Dead End Race.
Pogo is a character from the fourth One Piece movie. He is one of a duo of giants with Bobby. They competed in the Dead End Race.
Willy is a character from the fourth One Piece movie movie. He is an orca fish-man and the captain of a crew of fish-men that competed in the Dead End Race.

"Phantom Thief" Carina is a character who appears in Heart of Gold and One Piece Film: Gold. She is a thief who formerly worked as a songstress in Gran Tesoro, plotting to steal its riches. After helping the Straw Hat Pirates overthrow Gild Tesoro, Carina took command of Gran Tesoro.

The Red Line is a vast ring-like continent that wraps around the entire Blue Planet. It serves as a border separating the East and South Blues from the North and West Blues on both sides, as well as separating the two halves of the Grand Line. The Red Line is known to the giants of Elbaph as the "bloodstained snake" (血に染まるヘビ, chi ni somaru hebi).
It is mostly uninhabited, with the major exception of being home to the World Government's capital, Mary Geoise.

The Galley-La Company is a prominent company of shipwrights. The company, which has been established for seven years, builds ships for citizens and pirates, as well as for the World Government. Water 7, the island the company is on, is said to be the home of the best shipwrights in the world. The company is led by Iceburg, the mayor of Water 7 and the elder apprentice of the legendary shipwright Tom.

Poseidon is one of the three Ancient Weapons, alongside Pluton and Uranus. Poseidon is not an object but a living being: a mermaid endowed with the extraordinary ability to communicate with and command Sea Kings, which no other mermaid has.
The power is currently manifested in Shirahoshi, the 16-year-old mermaid princess of the Ryugu Kingdom.
A Sniper is a person adept at using, as well as maintaining, ranged weaponry.

Totto Land is an archipelago in the New World. It constitutes the main territory of one of the former Emperors, Big Mom, and her crew, the Big Mom Pirates, which extends around Whole Cake Island. It is navigable with a New World Log Pose.
According to Pekoms, it is considered one large, powerful nation, and Big Mom as its queen wants it to become a utopia that unifies all races of the world.
Totto Land is the general setting for the Whole Cake Island Arc.

The Kouzuki Family is a powerful family that ruled over Wano Country until their downfall twenty years ago at the hands of Kurozumi Orochi aided by Kaidou. The family has existed for centuries being responsible for the original invention of the Poneglyphs and formed close ties with the people of the Mokomo Dukedom on Zou.
After Kaidou and Orochi's defeats during the Raid on Onigashima, the Kouzuki family regained their position in the shogunate of Wano, led by Kouzuki Momonosuke.

Samurai are a class of noble warriors in Wano Country. Although the title is typically applied directly towards swordsmen, it can also be used as a generic term for all Wano Country warriors, including ninja and sumo wrestlers.
The Franky Family is a group of at least fifty ship dismantlers and Bounty Hunters from Water 7, brought together under the leadership of Cutty Flam (better known as Franky).
Captain is the sixth highest rank in the Marines.

The rank of a marine officer who commands a ship would not necessarily be "Captain". It may be higher (up to Fleet Admiral), or lower on small ships. By naval custom, any officer who is below the rank of Captain and commands a ship is addressed as "captain" while aboard that ship. The ship's captain also may be referred to as the Skipper.
The ranks within the Marine System are fairly straightforward, where each rank is clearly delineated.

Officers present at Marine Headquarters are considered the elite forces of the Marines, about three ranks higher in terms of power from those of the same rank at other bases. All ranks present from "Lieutenant" above are usually trained here, exceptions being those in command of other Marine bases which includes captain Nezumi and former captain Axe-Hand Morgan.
This page will list the Marine ranks and the soldiers who hold the titles.

The Kyoshiro Family is a yakuza group in Wano Country formerly led by the high-ranking money changer in service to the Kurozumi Family, Kyoshiro (who was Denjiro in disguise). After Denjiro revealed his identity as a member of the Nine Red Scabbards, they became enemies of Kurozumi Orochi and the Beasts Pirates during the Fire Festival and pledged themselves to the Kouzuki Family and the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.
Following Denjiro's appointment as daimyo of Kibi, the group's status is unknown.

G-8, officially Marine "Grand Line" Eighth Branch (海軍G・L第8支部, Kaigun Gurando Rain Dai-Hatchi Shibu), is a non-canon Marine Base occupying Navarone Island, with buildings along the coast and the most important ones built into a rock formation in the middle of the cape. The only way to enter and exit is through a large gate blocking the cape. It is the main setting of the G-8 Arc, in which the Straw Hat Pirates have to find their way out of the base.

The Marines of G-8 are fiercely proud of their base and island and berate those who undermine its importance. However, the base is "peace crazy"; it is one of the most heavily defended and armed of the marine bases (the main base alone sports a total of 108 cannons ), yet sees very little trouble. This has gotten to the point that the first four rules of G-8 marines involve eating one's meals completely.

A Shipwright is a carpenter who works specifically on ships. They are responsible for the building and repair of the ship, meaning most pirates need them around for general maintenance of their vessels. Other ships often have them as well.
The city of Water 7, in particular, is renowned worldwide for its highly skilled shipwrights.

SWORD is a Marine Headquarters Secret Special Force (機密特殊部隊, Kimitsu Tokushu Butai) that consists of Marines who have formally resigned themselves from the actual command structure of the organization, but still operate on its behalf.
The Night Butterfly Pirates are a pirate crew subordinate to the Red Hair Pirates led by Linaria.
The Charlotte Family is the family of the former Emperor Charlotte Linlin, also known as Big Mom.

Okama are people who were born male but have adopted various female traits, ranging from simply crossdressing to actually changing their biological sex. The Kamabakka Kingdom is the okama kingdom, although okama live all over the world.
Navarone is an anime-only island in Paradise that houses the Marine Base G-8. The island is where the G-8 Arc took place.
The WCI 31 is a group of Whole Cake Island's most renowned head chefs.
The Social Club are a pirate crew led by their bandmaster, Fugar. They are a subordinate crew to the Red Hair Pirates.

Newspapers are sources of printed news distributed both locally and worldwide, with worldwide newspapers being delivered by News Coo flying around the world. Wanted posters are often slipped into newspapers.
This page lists all animal species encountered in the Water 7 Saga.

The Walrus School is an elementary school and the main educational institution of Elbaph, hosted in the Warrior's Spring alongside the neighboring Owl Library and southwest of Western Village. Giant children between the ages of 18–36 (6–12 in human years) attend the school in order to learn about different subjects and socialize with other children.
It was founded 20 years ago by Jaguar D. Saul under the request of the late King of Elbaph, Harald.
